name: Shaun Taylor
bio: With a 25-year track record as a global CIO, COO, and Chief Transformation Officer, Shaun leads RCK Outcome Partners with one core philosophy: consulting should be about results, not billable hours. Under his leadership, RCK builds value-based, risk-sharing partnerships to tackle complex challenges, from M&A integrations and program recoveries to enterprise ERP implementations. Shaun and his practitioner-led team bring hands-on, C-suite expertise to deliver real, measurable enterprise value.
